score_scale.interpretation: maximum absolute column-sum scale of the design matrix; deterministic from fit input only

rationale: The logistic score component is a column-weighted sum of residual terms bounded by design-column absolute sums.
Normalizing score infinity norm by max(1, max absolute column sum) gives a dimensionless stationarity measure.
sqrt(binary64 epsilon) is fixed by machine precision and is chosen before any new real execution.
The rule is independent of optimizer success/status/message and does not use the observed F2 residual as a target.
